typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	datalakesnowgroupimporttbl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		GROUP_WF_GUID as string,
		GROUP_TYPE_SYS_ID as string,
		GROUP_NAME as string,
		GROUP_TYPE_NAME as string,
		GROUP_DESCRIPTION as string,
		GROUP_TYPE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		NAME as string,
		EMAIL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ORACLEDATALAKE
ORACLEDATALAKE derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		GROUP_NAME as string,
		GROUP_TYPE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GROUP_TYPE_NAME as string,
		GROUP_TYPE_SYS_ID as string,
		GROUP_WF_GUID as string,
		GROUP_DESCRIPTION as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		GROUP_NAME,
		GROUP_TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
		ImportDate,
		GROUP_TYPE_NAME,
		GROUP_TYPE_SYS_ID,
		GROUP_WF_GUID,
		GROUP_DESCRIPTION,
		EMAIL,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($datalakesnowgroupimporttbl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> datalakesnowgroupimporttbl
